faq_heading: Homes near Delta Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Delta Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Delta Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Delta Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Delta Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 173 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,322,500, townhomes $820,000, condos $577,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Delta Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Delta Secondary the median was 21 days on the market, closing at 97.0% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 173 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Delta Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ladner Elementary (0.5 km south-west), Delta Christian School (0.6 km north-east) and Port Guichon Elementary (1.2 km west).

Delta Secondary is a secondary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 4615 51 St. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Delta Secondary, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the Delta Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Delta Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Delta Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 173 homes sold within 2 km of Delta Secondary: 82 houses, 35 townhomes and 48 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,322,500.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Delta Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Delta Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Delta Secondary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 2 km of Delta Secondary was $1,322,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Delta Access, the nearest other secondary school, 1.4 km east of Delta Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
